summary_brief: 今日(10-18)日报草稿缺失，无法获取当天信号明细。基于可用的历史索引（共计84份日报，截至2026-10-16）评估：生态持续运行在9月下旬以来确立的\"安全治理+基础设施成熟+编排生产级\"主线上，无方向性转折。近期推进点集中在——OpenTelemetry可观测性标准化（10-14/15连续落地为全SDK统一标准）、企业级多代理OS（agno AgentOS）、多语言托管工具链（turbo setup）、Agent沙箱化执行与凭据安全。今日若延续此主线，应聚焦这些既有方向的具体落地节点，而非凭空认定新趋势。由于今天草案不可读，无法对今日新增信号给出准确的新推进点判断，需待草稿修复后重新分析。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 沙箱化与安全隔离成为跨项目共识
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: agno、Claude Code、DeepAgents 与 Codex 在同一天密集推出沙箱 harness 执行（Docker/微VM 隔离）、会话恢复与检查点持久化，标志编码代理从宿主机直接执行转向安全可控容器范式的行业级转向。

engineering_signals.title: 多模态实时交互与语音能力密集扩展
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: OpenAI Realtime Translation WebSocket 会话、Live 会话 Decisions 委托、opencode 实验性语音端点、OpenClaw 本地 Kokoro 神经 TTS 默认化，多项目同时将 AI 交互从纯文本推向实时语音与多模态，反映行业对语音 Agent 交互范式的集体押注。

engineering_signals.title: MCP 安全加固与 DNS 重绑定防护成焦点
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: ruflo 修复本地 MCP 服务 DNS 重绑定漏洞、Codex 收紧 MCP OAuth 资源级作用域、共同强调本地 MCP 接口的跨站访问风险，反映 MCP 生态快速扩张后的安全补课。

engineering_signals.title: 沙箱内凭据与内容治理强化（指纹审批与凭据隔离）
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Codex 插件审批绑定内容指纹、Playwright 修复代理凭据泄露至站点认证、Playwright trace 新增 secrets 脱敏，多个项目从不同层面堵住 Agent/浏览器自动化中的凭据与代码内容泄露路径，供应链安全成为共同优先项。

engineering_signals.title: LLM 流式与管道性能优化成为部署刚需
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Codex WebSocket zstd 压缩、Vercel AI SDK 单消费者流式降内存、Turborepo 缓存预取与归档管线重叠，多个项目聚焦降低流式传输延迟与内存驻留，反映 LLM 应用大规模部署成本与体验优化的共同瓶颈。

engineering_signals.title: 决策型 Agent 能力跨提供商/跨框架普及
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: OpenAI Live 会话 Decisions、Vercel AI SDK 接入 Perplexity decisions API 与 TypeSafe AI box 决策类型、opencode 模型推理模式可配置化，决策/推理型工作流从少数框架向多提供商多框架快速蔓延，成为 Agent 技术栈标准组件。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 可观测性与审计治理走向标准化
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Cline 桌面端 OTLP 链路导出、Goose 传播 W3C 追踪上下文至 MCP、Phoenix OTLP 日志导出、Playwright trace secrets 脱敏、deer-flow 阶段审批与不可变产物，可观测性与可审计性从单一工具扩展到跨 Agent 工作流的数据面。

engineering_signals.title: 自研 JS 运行时替换第三方引擎成工具链架构趋势

Default models change for 302.AI (Gemini 4 Argon), Eden AI and Prime Inference (Muse Spark Open), CoreWeave (Reflection Beam 1.0), NanoGPT, Pioneer (Nemotron 3.5 Super VL), and Scaleway (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash). releases.author: ruvnet
releases.summary:
Minor release: `@claude-flow/cli`, `claude-flow`, `ruflo` 3.57.0. A batch of community and dream-cycle fixes (#4210-#4252) plus a policy-ledger integrity fix (#3892). No standalone leaf republish needed this round.

### Security

- `ruflo init` / `init --dual` / `@claude-flow/codex init` no longer write a permissive `.codex/config.toml` by default. The generated file now uses `sandbox_mode = "workspace-write"`, `approval_policy = "on-request"` and `web_search = "cached"` (**standard** trust); the old `danger-full-access` / `never` / `live` file needs an explicit `--codex-trust full` (or `RUFLO_CODEX_TRUST=full`). `init` prints which level was written, an existing `.codex/config.toml` is never rewritten (not even with `--force`), and a kept permissive file is flagged with how to tighten it. Found by the three-host e2e run (ADR-490). `@claude-flow/codex` 3.0.4 (bundled, ships with the next train).
- The MCP bridge on loopback no longer accepts tool-call requests from an arbitrary web page: local-only mode now requires the `Host` to be loopback (blocks DNS rebinding) and the `Origin` to be loopback-or-allowlisted when no `MCP_AUTH_TOKEN` is set (#4226, #4243, @kevin9327).
- The policy ledger now authenticates a retained/pruned ledger against its independent on-disk archive anchor instead of trusting the mutable `state.json` alone, and streams full audits through fenced writers. Fixes `policy-ledger-verification-failed` on any install whose ledger has already been pruned (#3892, #4216, @proffesor-for-testing).

### Added

- `ruflo doctor` reports `better-sqlite3` copies compiled against Node 24.19+ headers when running Node 24.19–24.21, where they can abort the process (`Assertion failed: (env) != nullptr`, nodejs/node#65446), with the documented workarounds. `doctor --component native-addon` runs it alone (#4055, reported by @ronmikailov).
- `ruflo doctor` reports health checks as versioned JSON output (#4228, @bryanbans).

### Fixed

- `@metaharness/darwin` pin bumped from `~0.10.2` to `~0.12.0`, unblocking the `metaharness-pin-drift` CI gate repo-wide (#3219, #4252).
- Swarm: subscriber delivery is cancelled cleanly at shutdown, acknowledgements are tracked per recipient, urgent messages survive queue overflow, and failed/cancelled task workers release their slot (#4233, #4234, #4235, #4236, @rudycelekli). Coordinator cancellation stays terminal (#4244, @rudycelekli); domain pools stop creating unregistered agents and release agents after terminal tasks (#4246, #4247, @Tong-bit-art); shared worker reservations are honored across agent pools, fixing a case where that bookkeeping change would have silently defeated the domain-pool-release fix above (#4245, @rudycelekli).
- Learning stats read-merge-write transactions are serialized across processes, fixing lost concurrent increments (#4217, #4240, @rudycelekli).
- Claude memories refresh across project and worktree roots (#4210, @rudycelekli); the secret screen no longer treats a hyphen-named memory key as a credential field (#4202, #4211, @akushonkamen).
- Hook lifecycle events are distinguished during deduplication, fixing the Stop hook claiming the session-end de-dup key so later hooks never ran (#4206, #4212, @dajiaohuang); `init` omits unimplemented generated hooks (#4200, #4213, @dajiaohuang) and stops granting blanket execution of project helpers (#4221, @xiajiahang).
- Intelligence: trajectories are forwarded using the ruvllm contract (#4222, @xiajiahang); neural quantization reports unchanged persisted storage instead of a false delta (#4224, @dajiaohuang).
- Console: Mission Control's prose wraps at 80 columns (#3899, #4225, console 0.44.3, @korjavin); the mission ledger is keyed per project instead of leaking one project's active mission into every other (#4237, #4242, @kevin9327).
- `daemon status` reports the running daemon's actual TTL instead of a stale `--ttl 0` default (#4238, #4241, @kevin9327).
- CLI: `--no-color` is honored for help and version output, and `--no-update` is honored before the startup update check runs (#4248, #4251, @shuaiyafei).
- `dream(performance)`: `RaftConsensus.awaitConsensus()` is event-driven instead of busy-polling (#4214, #4215).
- Docs: 25 user guide links repaired to v3 packages (#4223, @ketpatil77); ABP-governed SGit memory checkpoints and Ruflo CLI recovery validation documented (#4239, @mondweep).

Not included: #4220 (helper-execution-permission fix) touches a signed helper manifest and needs a re-sign with the private key before merge, held for a follow-up release. #4216's own large diff (ledger integrity) was reviewed in depth separately before merging, given it gates MCP tool-call authorization.

key_changes: ruflo init 系列命令默认不再生成宽松权限的 .codex/config.toml，改为使用标准信任级别（sandbox_mode=workspace-write、approval_policy=on-request），需要完全权限需显式指定 --codex-trust full

releases.summary:
## What's changed

- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_MODEL` to choose the model the client-side auto mode classifier uses; it does not change the model for server-side auto mode
- Added an `Idle compaction` row to `/config` for turning idle compaction off or back on; the notices shown after an idle compaction now say how to turn it off
- Added a notice to `/design-sync` and `/design-login` that standalone Claude Design (claude.ai/design) closes by December 14, 2026
- Fixed a "Prompt is too long" error when stopping a turn while the conversation was being compacted
- Fixed requests failing with "diagnostics: Extra inputs are not permitted" after switching to Vertex or Bedrock mid-session
- Fixed the Read tool loading an image file of any size, or a pipe or device named like an image, entirely into memory; image sources over 128 MB are now refused
- Fixed `/autocompact` and `/effort` saving to the wrong model when a gateway names Opus 4 or 4.1 with a prefix, such as `anthropic/claude-opus-4-1`
- Fixed a prompt cache miss when a tool added mid-session was loaded again through ToolSearch or after compaction
- Fixed `claude plugin` and other subcommands sometimes exiting before a queued settings or config write finished, which could lose the change or leave a `.tmp` file behind
- Fixed plugin marketplaces re-cloning on every refresh, and newly installed git plugins showing version "unknown", when git defaults to the reftable ref format
- Fixed the PowerShell tool not finding commands in a plugin's `bin/` folder, and reporting an error when a search that finds nothing (rg, grep, findstr, git grep) is piped into `Select-Object` or another formatting cmdlet
- Fixed Claude in the desktop app pointing you to claude.ai settings or `/mcp` to authorize or reconnect an MCP server where that option isn't available
- Fixed artifact publishes sometimes failing when Claude sent an empty list of edits, and Claude retrying an artifact update the wrong way after a newer version of the artifact turned it away
- Fixed `classifier_category` missing from OpenTelemetry `tool_decision` events for most auto mode classifier blocks, and new `tool_decision` attributes pushing out `tool_use_id`, `tool_source` and `tool_parameters` when `OTEL_LOGRECORD_ATTRIBUTE_COUNT_LIMIT` is low
- Fixed rows in the agents view staying blank after moving down a long list or folding a section
- Fixed `claude remote-control --help` not printing its usage and exiting when not signed in
- Fixed `/design consent` and `/design revoke` suggesting `/design-login` when they fail in a cloud session, where it isn't available; the message now points to claude.ai/design/settings
- Fixed MCP servers showing no tools, or every tool call failing, when the server negotiates protocol version 2026-07-28 but omits `resultType`, `ttlMs` or `cacheScope`
- Fixed prompt suggestions spending usage credits on models your plan pays for only with credits: they are now skipped after a reply billed to credits
- Fixed URLs written in backticks being clickable only on their first row when they wrap; the whole URL is now one link in terminals that support hyperlinks
- Fixed `claude plugin details <name>@builtin` suggesting `claude plugin list`, which never shows built-in plugins, when the plugin isn't found; it now points to `/plugin`
- Fixed an emoji that a link starts inside wrapping one column too wide, which hid it in question previews and turned tables into lists
- Fixed worktree isolation refusing to create or resume worktrees under git 2.56 or later when a stray `.git` file points at a directory that doesn't exist
- Fixed a cloud session's cost and usage restarting from zero after the session resumed in a new process
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed git fetches failing with "bad object refs/heads" in sessions that reuse a checkout stored in git's reftable format
- Windows: Fixed every file write being refused or asked about for projects on exFAT or FAT32 drives, including in sessions started with `--plugin-dir`
- Improved startup time with many plugins enabled: plugin command and agent files now take far fewer file system calls to load, most of all on Windows
- Improved auto mode with the server-side classifier: a conversation too long for the safety check is now compacted, instead of every checked tool call being denied
- Improved the message when a background session reopened from another folder has no LLM gateway: it now says why, instead of "Not logged in"
- Changed `claude -p` and Agent SDK sessions with no permission mode to start in `default` mode on third-party providers, with telemetry off or on a fresh install; `--permission-mode auto` keeps auto
- Changed fork subagents (`subagent_type: "fork"`) to be on by default in `claude -p`, the Agent SDK, the desktop app and VS Code, as they already are in the terminal; `CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=0` turns them off, and `claude mcp serve` never offers them
- Changed the desktop app and VS Code to always run the main conversation's subagents in the background, as the terminal does, rather than let Claude choose; a subagent's own Agent calls in `claude -p`, the Agent SDK, the desktop app and VS Code now run in the foreground by default
- Changed the `← for agents` footer hint to hide 10 seconds after a session opens; the count of agents waiting on you still shows
- Changed where the Claude in Chrome instructions sit in the system prompt so that new conversations can read them from the shared prompt cache
- Changed prompt and agent hooks so that at most 12 of one event run at a time; the rest wait their turn
- Changed the message shown when your organization's policy turns off `/feedback`: it now points to GitHub issues instead of an organization admin
- [VSCode] Fixed text after an unclosed code block in a list showing as plain text while a reply streams, then turning into code
- [VSCode] Fixed MCP server sign-in from the panel opening a broken authorization page when the server URL contains a query string
- [VSCode] Fixed the `@browser` banner saying "Browser connected" when no browser with the Claude extension can be reached
- [Cloud sessions] Added a banner on a routine's page that says why its last run didn't start, such as your organization reaching its limit on concurrent cloud sessions
- [Cloud sessions] Fixed "Rewind to here" failing on every message except the newest in cloud sessions; self-hosted runners need Claude Code v2.1.246 or later
- [Cloud sessions] Fixed the pull request status bar in cloud sessions flipping a pull request with merge conflicts back to ready while GitHub rechecked it
- [Cloud sessions] Fixed routine runs showing as Completed after their cloud session stopped unexpectedly, and as Cancelled when archived before they started, instead of failed
- [Cloud sessions] Fixed the diff view in cloud sessions missing changes or failing to load after the session's GitHub repository was renamed or moved
- [Cloud sessions] Fixed a scheduled routine run that failed partway being run again from the start an hour or more later, which could repeat work such as posting the same report twice
- [Cloud sessions] Fixed an open cloud session sometimes not showing messages sent from another device until you reloaded the page or clicked away and back
- [Cloud sessions] Improved the error shown when a cloud session fails to start: it now says "Connection lost" or "Server error" instead of "Something went wrong"
- [Remote Control] Fixed a subagent's pane spinning forever in a Remote Control session after your computer goes offline; it now says Remote Control is disconnected
- [Claude Tag] Fixed "is thinking…" staying up under a mention in a Slack channel or DM after Claude answered it by editing one of its earlier messages
- [Claude Tag] Fixed URLs in code blocks under a numbered or bulleted step of Claude's Slack replies being wrapped in angle brackets, which broke copied commands
- [Claude Tag] Fixed HEIC, SVG, TIFF and BMP images attached in Slack never reaching Claude; they now arrive as files in its working files, like other file types
- [Claude Tag] Fixed new channel managers losing access to Claude in Slack in organizations that restrict Claude Tag by role; the manager role now also grants Claude Tag in Slack
- [Claude Tag] Fixed custom connectors whose MCP servers share one host showing as a single connector in Claude Tag admin settings; each server is now its own connector
- [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack sometimes answering a direct message with "DMs are temporarily unavailable" and dropping it when a single Slack lookup stalled; it now retries first
- [Claude Tag] Fixed direct messages with Claude on a Slack Enterprise Grid ignoring Slack's workspace dropdown; they now run under the connected workspace you last opened Claude in
- [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack's notice for a channel's monthly spend limit saying a channel manager can raise it; it now names an organization owner and links the usage page
- [Claude Tag] Fixed links in Claude's Slack replies absorbing the closing bold or italic marks, or full-width punctuation, right after them, which broke the link and the formatting
- [Claude Tag] Improved repository search in Claude Tag admin settings to cover up to 100 connected GitHub accounts and find private repositories past the first 5,000 of a GitHub App install
- [Claude Tag] Improved Add place in Claude Tag admin settings to list a channel you type or paste right away, instead of only after your organization's full channel list has loaded
- [Claude Tag] Improved Add > Domain on a workspace's or channel's page in Claude Tag admin settings to be available once that page loads, not only after every channel has loaded
- [Claude Tag] Changed Claude Tag admin settings to organize Claude's access into four tabs: Bundles, Connectors, Skills and plugins, and Channels
- [Claude Tag] Changed the Roles page in organization settings to group the roles created for Claude Tag channel managers in a collapsed section below your organization's own roles
- [Code Review] Fixed Code Review setup not resuming after you leave to connect GitHub; back in admin settings, it now reopens at the repository picker

releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.summary:
- Plugins now run only in worker threads (the default, `CLINE_PLUGIN_MODE=worker`) or in the subprocess sandbox (`sandbox`). The `in_process` mode is removed, along with its silent fallback. A host that ships no `plugin-sandbox-bootstrap.js` fails every plugin load with `PluginBootstrapMissingError`, which names `CLINE_PLUGIN_BOOTSTRAP_PATH`, instead of quietly running plugins inside the hub. The hub daemon's uncaught error handlers are fatal again. The SSH remote hub ships no bootstrap yet, so it reports plugin tools as missing
- Provider errors that arrive after a model stream has started are retried up to 3 times, and the final failure is reported as an error in logs and Langfuse traces. Exhausted retries no longer also trigger the agent's whole-turn retry, so retry budgets don't multiply
- Model request failure logs include the provider's request id
- `setHubDaemonLauncher` lets an embedding host start the hub daemon through a bundled Cline CLI, and `ensureDetachedHubServer` gains a `beforeSpawn` hook that runs only when a new daemon actually starts. The standalone SSH remote helper entrypoint is removed: SSH remotes run the hub through the uploaded Cline CLI
- `NodeHubClient` accepts `resolveConnectionHeaders`, so a remote proxy's WebSocket upgrade can be authenticated with HTTP headers refreshed on every reconnect. It is threaded through `HubRuntimeHost` and `RemoteRuntimeHost`
- `AskQuestionExecutor` may return text and image blocks, so attachments sent with an answer reach the model
- New `buildTelemetrySelfcheckReport` export in `@cline/shared`
- The `cline` provider's bundled default (the first Cline recommended model) is now Gemini 4 Argon instead of Claude Sonnet 5.5, because the recommended list now leads with it
- Refreshed the model catalog (6,862 → 6,952 models). Adds the Boundless and Standard Compute providers, and SambaNova now comes from the catalog with MiniMax M3 as its default. The Cline recommended list adds Gemini 4 Argon and drops Grok 4.7, and the Cline free list replaces Step 5 Preview with Nemotron 3.5 Super VL. OpenCode Go no longer lists MiniMax M2.7. Default models change for Cortecs, CrossModel, Eden AI, Google Gemini, GitHub Copilot, Google Vertex AI, LLM Gateway, Ofox, OpenCode Go, and Prime Inference (Gemini 4 Argon), Fireworks AI, Nebius Token Factory, and Requesty (Muse Spark Open), CoreWeave, DigitalOcean, NanoGPT, and Nvidia (Nemotron 3.5 Super VL), Aixy and Neon (Claude Haiku 5.5), Agnes AI, Ambient, IteraCompute, Poe, Scaleway, and SenseNova

key_changes: 插件运行模式重大变更：移除了 in_process 模式，插件仅在工作线程或子进程沙箱中运行，未提供 bootstrap 文件的主机将直接报错而非静默降级

ai_summary.summary_cn: 此版本为 Breaking Change 级别更新，核心变更是移除插件 in_process 运行模式，强制要求插件在工作线程或子进程沙箱中运行，未正确配置的主机将直接失败。同时移除了独立 SSH 远程助手入口点、重构了 hub 守护进程启动机制，并大幅刷新了模型目录（新增 6862→6952 个模型），更新了多个提供商（如 Cline 默认推荐模型改为 Gemini 4 Argon）的默认模型配置。

releases.author: kausmeows
releases.summary:
# Changelog

## New Features:

- **Sandboxed Harness Agents**: `ClaudeAgent` and `CodexAgent` take a `sandbox=` parameter and run the whole harness process inside an isolated, per-session computer instead of on the host, with session state that survives losing the container, the host or the replica that ran the last turn. No new classes to hold: `ClaudeAgent(id="coder", db=PostgresDb(...), sandbox=DockerSandbox("agno-sandbox:local", network="isolated"))` is the whole setup, and the agent builds its coordinator from its `PostgresDb` on first use. Each turn claims the session through a lease row in the agent's Postgres (`<session_table>_sandbox_bindings`, created on first use), starts compute restored from the session's last committed checkpoint (workspace plus the harness's own conversation files), runs the turn, then captures and verifies a new checkpoint and publishes the run row and recovery point in one transaction. A cancelled or failed turn publishes nothing and the previous checkpoint stays the recovery point. The turn refuses to continue on state it cannot verify: it passes the native conversation id (Claude session id, Codex thread id) committed with the last checkpoint, and a restore that lost it fails with `native_state_missing` before the model runs instead of silently starting a new conversation. Typed harness settings travel to the runtime as JSON; host-only settings (`cwd`, `retries`, `env`, native option objects) are rejected by name at construction. `require_native_resume` and `strict_persistence` are new options on `BaseExternalAgent`, and `agno[claude]` / `agno[codex]` install extras cover the harness SDKs. See [cookbook](https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/blob/main/cookbook/frameworks/sandbox/docker/sandbox_claude.py). (#11028, #11043, #11056, #11057)
- **Docker Sandbox**: `DockerSandbox` is the customer-operated provider. Containers run as UID 1000 with a read-only image filesystem, dropped capabilities, no privilege escalation, CPU, memory and process limits, bounded tmpfs for `/workspace` and `/runtime`, no host or Docker socket mounts, and only explicitly configured environment values plus the harness's model API key. Networking defaults to `none`; `network="isolated"` gives a managed bridge with inter-container traffic off, and `subnet=` picks its range. Deterministic session and generation identity reconciles creation races and lost responses; commands are never retried automatically. `pause` / `resume` are provided through the kernel freezer, and `DockerCheckpointTransfer` moves checkpoints in and out. `cookbook/frameworks/sandbox/build_image.py` builds the runtime image. See [cookbook](https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/blob/main/cookbook/frameworks/sandbox/docker/docker_execution.py). (#10975, #11028)
- **Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Sandbox**: `AgentCoreSandbox` implements the same contract on AgentCore Runtime, with `AgentCoreCheckpointTransfer` next to the Docker transfer. Each sandbox generation is one AgentCore runtime session in a Firecracker microVM; `create` is idempotent through a session id derived from the namespace, agent, session and generation. A root server on port 8080 claims the microVM, starts the runtime as UID 1000, fences every later operation with the claimed configuration and a random incarnation so a stale handle can never act on a later claim, forwards start and poll calls, and runs commands behind a guard that drops to UID 1000 in `/workspace`. Checkpoints stop UID 1000 processes during capture and restore and move through `InvokeAgentRuntime` in chunks, up to 2 GiB. Pause is not supported and AgentCore session storage is not used. The provider packages moved to `agno.sandbox.docker` and `agno.sandbox.agentcore`; `DockerCheckpointTransfer` now imports from `agno.sandbox.docker`. The runtime also gained two Codex fixes that apply to Docker as well: it creates `CODEX_HOME`, and it logs Codex in from `OPENAI_API_KEY` when no stored login matches, since checkpoints exclude `auth.json`. `cookbook/frameworks/sandbox/agentcore/agentcore_setup.py` builds, pushes and deploys the runtime. See [cookbook](https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/blob/main/cookbook/frameworks/sandbox/agentcore/sandbox_claude_agentcore.py). (#11050)
- **Warm Sandbox Turns**: The coordinator keeps a session's computer for `warm_computer_seconds` (default 300) after a turn instead of destroying it: paused on Docker, left idle on AgentCore. The next turn inside that window resumes it and restores nothing; otherwise it retires the old computer and takes the cold path on a fresh generation restored from the checkpoint. The checkpoint is still captured after every turn, so a warm computer is only a shortcut to the state the checkpoint already holds. `metadata.sandbox.resumed` on every completed run says which path the turn took, and `retire_computer` / `sweep_warm` on the coordinator remove computers that sessions never came back for. Live on Docker a warm Claude turn took 4.6 s against 8.2 s cold; on AgentCore 3.3 s against 8.2 s. See [cookbook](https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/blob/main/cookbook/frameworks/sandbox/warm_turns.py). (#11088)
- **Sandbox Through AgentOS**: `POST /agents/{agent_id}/runs` for a sandboxed agent submits foreground, streaming and background requests to the durable queue with no new endpoints. An `Idempotency-Key` retry returns the same run, while a different session, input, options or attachment bytes returns 409. Clients reconnect with `/runs/{run_id}/resume` (`last_event_index`) and cancel with `/runs/{run_id}/cancel`, including across replicas: a cancel settled on another replica now records the run as cancelled and keeps the user's turn on the run row. AgentOS fails at startup if a sandboxed agent has no Postgres to coordinate on, refuses the host-local default checkpoint store once a queue worker is active, and validates each sandboxed agent's bindings table at startup and before a submission, naming the remedy for a table from an earlier build. See [cookbook](https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/blob/main/cookbook/frameworks/sandbox/docker/sandbox_claude_agentos.py). (#11043, #11105)
- **Attachments for Sandboxed Agents**: `run` / `arun` on a sandboxed `ClaudeAgent` or `CodexAgent` accept `images=` and `files=`, and the AgentOS run route accepts them as uploads. Only bytes cross into the sandbox: each attachment is validated and encoded before any durable write, staged under `/workspace/.agno/uploads/<run_id>/` by the harness's own staging, and kept in the turn's checkpoint so later turns on a new computer can still read it. A request carries at most 16 attachments and 512 KiB in total; URLs, media references, server file paths, audio and video are refused. Queued runs store the attachments with the submission, so a retry sends the same bytes. See [cookbook](https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/blob/main/cookbook/frameworks/sandbox/docker/sandbox_attachments.py). (#10990, #11091)
- **Images and PDFs Inline for Claude Code**: `ClaudeAgent` now sends attached images (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WEBP) and PDFs up to 4 MiB inside the message as content blocks, the form the Agent SDK's streaming input takes, instead of only writing them to disk for Claude's Read tool. Claude sees the picture directly and never reads the file back, which used to return the whole file as base64 and overflow the SDK's 1 MiB message buffer and the sandbox's 256 KiB event frame for images of a few hundred KB. Whether a file goes inline is decided from its bytes, so a mislabelled file stays on disk for the file tools; other files and larger images keep the Read path. See [cookbook](https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/blob/main/cookbook/frameworks/sandbox/docker/sandbox_image_sizes.py). (#11115)
- **Queue Per Session**: Durable background runs on one session now execute at most one at a time, in submission order, for every component. Each ticket carries a store-assigned `session_seq`; a ticket is claimed only while no sibling in its session is running or paused and no earlier sibling is still queued, so waiting tickets spend no attempt and no worker slot. Different sessions stay concurrent within `max_concurrency`. A paused run holds its session, a continued or retried run keeps its place, and a PENDING run poll carries `waiting_on` with the run it is blocked behind. `QueueConfig.queue_per_session` (default on) controls it, external agents are serialized regardless, and `GET /config` reports the effective setting. See [cookbook](https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/blob/main/cookbook/05_agent_os/background_tasks/queue_per_session.py). (#9587)
- **Instant Durable Submissions**: The replica that accepts a durable submission wakes its own queue worker after the ticket commits, so the run starts in milliseconds instead of waiting up to `poll_interval` for the next poll. A saturated replica wakes on slot release, and peers still pick up jobs on their own poll. Durability is untouched: the row is committed before anyone is woken. (#9667)
- **ChartTools**: New toolkit with a single `create_chart` tool that validates a chart payload (`bar`, `line`, `area`, `pie`, `bar-horizontal`, `bar-stacked`, `area-stacked`) and returns a ready fenced chart block for Agno OS to render, replacing the schema prompt users had to carry. Validation failures tell the model what to fix, and the toolkit ships its own instructions, so `tools=[ChartTools()]` is all an agent needs. See [cookbook](https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/blob/main/cookbook/05_agent_os/chart_responses/agentos_chart_responses.py). (#8295)

## Improvements:

- **Durable Queue for Db-Backed and Factory Components**: Background runs on components created through the components API, on version-pinned runs, and on `AgentFactory` / `TeamFactory` / `WorkflowFactory` submissions now ride the durable queue instead of dropping to a detached task on the accepting replica. The accepting endpoint stamps a resolution scope on the ticket (source, owner, version, and for factories the trusted claims and factory input), and the worker replays that resolution at claim time. A factory that reads `ctx.request` on the worker fails the run with a message naming the fix, since the live request cannot ride the ticket. The run read routes for factory runs no longer answer 400 on every poll. See [cookbook](https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/blob/main/cookbook/05_agent_os/21_factories/08_durable_queue.py). (#9796, #11045)
- **Codex Permission Policy Naming**: `CodexAgent(sandbox="read-only")` is renamed `sandbox_mode`, matching Codex's own config key, since `sandbox=` now takes a provider. The old string form still works with a `DeprecationWarning`. (#11043)
- **Sandbox Cookbooks**: `cookbook/frameworks/sandbox/` is split into `docker/` and `agentcore/` folders, each with its own README and test log, covering the provider, checkpoints, the coordinator, recovery, cancellation, attachments, warm turns and AgentOS. `build_image.py` loads the built tag into the image store and verifies it is there. (#11050, #11081, #11105)
- **Gemini Cookbooks**: Updated to the current models and API. (#11038)

## Bug Fixes:

- **Sandbox Checkpoint Restore**: Every second turn in a sandbox session failed with `getent unable to find entry "1000:1000" in passwd database`, because `docker cp --archive` asks the daemon to resolve the container's user as a name. Restore now copies without archive mode and pins every restored entry to 1000:1000 itself. (#11094)
- **Sandbox Store and Coordinator**: A queue cancel racing a worker claim of the same run could deadlock on lock order; the stop path now takes the session, run and binding in the same order as every other store transaction. Sync calls through `DockerSandbox` leaked an HTTP client per call. Cancelled sandbox runs now record the `EXECUTING` cancellation stage the queue expects. A run marked finished between cleanup and commit goes through the stop path instead of leaving the binding in `finalizing`, and long provider calls extend their lease. (#11057, #11092)
- **Sandbox Submissions**: Submitting with a `user_id` to a session created without one, or the reverse, answers 404 before any ticket exists instead of a 500 with a cancelled job left behind. A foreground request whose job failed before its run row existed returns the ticket's error as a 500 instead of a 503 asking the client to reconnect. (#11105)
- **WebSocket Tails**: With a durable queue, a chat client that sent a second message while a workflow run was streaming over the WebSocket stopped getting events for the first run. Tail pumps are now keyed per (socket, run), a re-subscribe replaces only that run's pump, and a socket may attach up to 32 runs. (#11039)
- **API Docs Order**: The FileSystem routes are registered after the Database routes on setup and resync, so the generated API docs list them in order. (#11099)
- **Tests**: The WebSocket factory workflow tests pin the inline path they were written for, after factory submissions started riding the durable queue. (#11106)

## What's Changed
* fix: let db-backed components ride the durable queue by @ysolanky in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/9796
* feat: queue per session - at most one live run per session (head-of-line durable claims) by @ysolanky in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/9587

## Core

### Bugfixes
- OpenCode 1 now stays on the 1.x release line: update checks use only the npm `opencode-ai` latest version, so 1.x installs are never offered a 2.x build as a regular update.
- Upgrading to OpenCode 2 remains a separate, explicit choice through the 2.0 offer in `/update` or `opencode upgrade --major`.
- Fix upgrades for installs managed by yarn.
- Skip 1.x updates for Homebrew Core installs, which now track OpenCode 2, and check tap and Chocolatey availability before offering an update.
- The install script refuses to install 2.x versions.

key_changes: OpenCode 1.x 版本现在保持独立的更新线，仅检查 npm 上 opencode-ai 的最新 1.x 版本，不会将 2.x 版本作为常规更新推送给 1.x 用户
升级到 OpenCode 2 需要通过 /update 命令或 opencode upgrade --major 明确选择，而非自动升级
修复了 yarn 管理的安装包的升级问题
Homebrew Core 安装不再接收 1.x 更新（已跟踪 OpenCode 2），安装脚本拒绝安装 2.x 版本

key_changes: 新增 `turbo setup` 工具管理能力，支持 Node、pnpm、Rust、Go、uv/Python、Bun、Yarn 等多生态工具链的锁定、下载、安装与激活
新增 `turbo exec` 命令，可在托管环境中执行命令
大量性能优化，包括锁文件解析提速、缓存读写并行化、并行复制剪枝文件、多线程 zstd 压缩等
多项修复：Windows 平台兼容性、Ctrl+C 中断处理、非 UTF-8 参数、缓存恢复安全等
ai_summary.summary_cn: Turbo 2.11.9 是一次以新增「托管工具链（turbo setup）」为主的大版本更新，大幅扩展了工具链管理能力，可自动解析并锁定 Node、Rust、Go、Python、Bun、Yarn、pnpm 等各生态版本并安全安装激活。同时包含大量性能优化（锁文件解析、缓存并行化等）与跨平台兼容性修复，并新增 turbo exec 命令。

issue_insights.summary_brief: 本批 5 个跨仓库候选汇聚为三类高影响共性问题：工作流运行期错误（streaming/SSE 解析、回退与上下文恢复导致主流程挂起或错误完成）、认证与权限（多租户隔离失效、会话状态泄漏、Auto mode 误拦截）、以及计费与配额（usage 计费非幂等导致重复扣费）。其中计数最高（156）的“带采样参数的 Anthropic 评估器崩溃”本质是 SDK 与新版 anthropic>=1 API 签名不兼容的跨仓库共性问题。
global_highlights: 流式/SSE 协议解析缺陷呈系统性扩散：anthropic-sdk 的 Go/Java/Python/TypeScript 四语言实现同时存在 UTF-8 BOM 吞掉首事件、CR-only 流不产出事件、长上下文 prefill 缓存被无效重置等问题，涉及 25 个以上仓库，属 SDK 协议实现层共因。
会话状态与身份隔离防线多处失守：登出未清理管理员模拟状态（AutoGPT）、跨组织 Agent 调度越权（SuperAGI）、OAuth2 授权循环与 session_store 跨用户续聊（phoenix/claude-agent-sdk-python），共同指向认证会话生命周期管理缺陷。
usage 计费幂等性缺失成为跨平台普遍痛点：AutoGPT 节点恢复重复计费、Claude Code 零请求被扣用量、bot 订阅状态与实际不符，多个产品在开关 CLI/SDK/托管入口上计费口径不一致。
回退与恢复路径的错误语义处理普遍错误：anthropic-sdk 的 Go/TS 回退中间件会把会话钉死在未成功的模型或吞掉取消/超时错误，AutoGPT/agno 在人工审核恢复时丢失执行上下文导致已拒绝操作仍执行。

top_pain_points.topic: aider 在 macOS arm64 上生成 repo map 时因 scipy _spropack 动态库 dlopen 失败（_svdp.py line 23 ImportError）而崩溃退出，主流程完全不可用
top_pain_points.summary: aider 0.86.2 在 macOS arm64 上生成 repo map 时因 scipy _spropack 动态库 dlopen 失败（_svdp.py line 23 ImportError）而崩溃退出，主流程完全不可用。
top_pain_points.review_reason: 多个不同用户在 macOS arm64 (Darwin 27) 上运行 aider 0.86.2 时，生成 repo map 调用 networkx pagerank 触发 scipy 导入，_spropack 动态库 dlopen（'__DATA/__thread_bss' zero-fill section 报错）失败，抛出 uncaught exception 使程序直接崩溃退出，无法完成任何编码对话。同版本同 traceback 被 11 个用户不同 Python 版本反复报告，属高频主流程阻断性崩溃，用户主功能不可用。

source_issues.title: Uncaught ImportError in _svdp.py line 986
source_issues.evidence: macOS arm64, aider 0.86.2, 生成 repo map 时 networkx pagerank 触达 scipy to_scipy_sparse_array 进而 _svdp.py line 23 导入 _spropack 报 ImportError: _spropack.cpython-311-darwin.so dlopen 失败 '__DATA/__thread_bss' has a zero-fill section type but offset field is not zero, uncaught exception 崩溃

source_issues.title: Uncaught ImportError in _svdp.py line 23
source_issues.evidence: 同一 _svdp.py line 23 ImportError, scipy _propack._spropack cp312-darwin.so dlopen 失败, Darwin 27.0.0, 崩溃

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Creating a conversation always fails: the sandbox agent cannot find the plugin schema.
source_issues.evidence: 新建会话启动卡在 SETTING_UP_SKILLS 然后 500，因沙箱 bundle 缺少 openhands/sdk/plugin/format/schemas/plugin-1.0.0.schema.json；通过 API 同样 500，无 app_conversation_id。对所有新会话完全失败。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: migration 029 errors with `duplicate column name: consecutive_auth_failures` on SQLite
source_issues.evidence: HUMAN 报告：迁移失败静默杀死了 automation server，用户升级后没注意到服务没在跑，需借助 agent 调试；每次重启都同样失败，automation 接口全部 ECONNREFUSED。

source_issues.title: A leading UTF-8 BOM hides the first SSE event or error
source_issues.evidence: SSE 状态机把开头的 U+FEFF BOM 当作首字段名的一部分，流以 ﻿event: message_start 开头时丢失该事件，以 event:error 开头时可能隐藏流式错误，data: 为首字段时首个 payload 被丢弃。

source_issues.title: Deno: extension upload fails at launch — SDK FormData rejects null (Received null for "file[fd]")
source_issues.evidence: 正文给出完整错误栈：Error: Failed to upload the Stagehand extension；cause: TypeError: Received null for "file[fd]"；给出最小复现代码，在 Deno 2.9.4 上每次启动都在扩展上传阶段失败，页面尚未可用，且无绕过自动上传的方式；workaround 为固定版本 3.7.3。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: "could not find vendor" error on v1.4.452 despite correct configuration in .env and config.yaml
source_issues.evidence: 配置 .env/config.yaml 指向 Ollama 后运行 fabric --pattern 仍报 could not find vendor；--vendor Ollama --model gemma3:4b 同样 no AI vendors configured to read models from；降级到 v1.4.322 用同一份配置即恢复，说明 v1.4.452 vendor 初始化逻辑回归，主流程完全不可用。

source_issues.title: 1.17.1 regression: /console/api/installed-apps 500 on MySQL-compatible engines (OceanBase) — ORDER BY ... NULLS LAST unsupported
source_issues.evidence: pymysql 1064 SQL 语法错误，NULLS LAST 不被 OceanBase 解析；3/3 确定性复现，1.16.x 正常

source_issues.title: Installed apps list returns 500 on MySQL (`NULLS LAST` syntax error)
source_issues.evidence: 相同根因在标准 MySQL 上触发 500，确认同源缺陷

source_issues.title: Windows sandbox fails with error 32 while Codex desktop is open; works when closed.
source_issues.evidence: 沙箱命令在关闭桌面时成功、开启时必失败；日志报 node_repl.exe/VCRUNTIME140_1.dll 上 error 32 共享冲突导致 setup refresh failed

top_pain_points.topic: 使用 Anthropic 模型的评估器在设置 temperature/top_p/top_k 后每次调用都崩溃
top_pain_points.summary: phoenix-evals 的 AnthropicAdapter 将评估器调用参数原样转发给 client.messages.create(),而 anthropic>=1 已从签名移除这些参数,导致使用 Anthropic LLM 并设置 temperature 的评估器每次调用都抛 TypeError,连文档示例用法也触发,覆盖 generate_text/generate_object 及 async 版本,该配置下的评估功能完全不可用。

top_pain_points.review_reason: 按文档示例设置 temperature 即导致评估器每次调用崩溃抛异常,Anthropic 提供商的评估关键功能在该配置下不可用,有明确复现,直接影响用户评估工作流。

source_issues.title: [BUG]: [playground] AWS Bedrock run crashes with JSONDecodeError when a tool result message contains plain text
source_issues.evidence: json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Extra data line 1 column 4 (char 3); 工具结果为普通文本时 BedrockClient 在请求前 json.loads 崩溃

source_issues.title: [online evals] [bug] Cannot save project evaluators
source_issues.evidence: 无法保存 project evaluators(附报错截图)

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Run-failure banner disappears after reload (error invisible, user message left unanswered)
source_issues.evidence: 运行以 LLM/tool 失败结束时，失败横幅仅存在于内存 store（useErrorMessageStore），页面刷新后失败不可见，用户消息留在会话里无回复无报错，读起来像 agent 静默忽略请求；移动端频繁 tab 恢复受影响最大。可见 ConversationErrorEvent 但 UI 无任何 error-message-banner。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: LLM errors not propagated to the frontend
source_issues.evidence: 用户用 Nebius 时模型不存在(404)，错误只在服务端日志出现，UI 只显示 error 而无错误详情，用户无法排查。

source_issues.title: SendDiscordMessageBlock hangs until block timeout when channel.send fails (exception in on_ready handler never closes the client)
source_issues.evidence: on_ready 处理器内无 try/finally，channel.send 抛 Forbidden/HTTPException 时被 discord.py 吞掉，client.close() 永不执行，block 挂起直到默认 30 分钟超时，唯一可见记录是服务端日志行，用户看不到任何错误

source_issues.title: Resuming after a human review rebuilds ExecutionContext without graph_exec_id/user_id: rejected irreversible actions still run, later ones skip review, media blocks fail
source_issues.evidence: 恢复时构建的 ExecutionContext 无 user_id/graph_id/graph_exec_id，_execute 仅在 graph_exec_id 非空时才做敏感操作复核，导致被拒绝的不可逆动作照常执行、后续不可逆块不再暂停、store_media_file 等抛出 ValueError: execution_context.graph_exec_id is required

source_issues.title: Admin requeue of stuck QUEUED executions is a silent no-op (QUEUED->QUEUED rejected, nothing published, success returned)
source_issues.evidence: 三个管理员重发端点筛选 QUEUED 后调用 add_graph_execution，但 VALID_STATUS_TRANSITIONS 不允许 QUEUED->QUEUED，导致写更新不匹配、发布被跳过，而接口仍返回 success:true/requeued_count>=1，执行保持卡死

source_issues.title: Custom provider mirroring a known provider silently loses vision support (vision lookup is keyed on the raw provider name
source_issues.evidence: 自定义提供商 (fireworks-live, engine:openai) 指向知名后端时所有图像输入被静默丢弃，即使 goose 自身将该模型列为 supports_vision。图像被本地替换为占位文本，从未发送给模型。改为规范名即恢复视觉。根因:模型能力解析按键并在 (provider_name, model_name)，catalog_provider_id 未用于运行时视觉解析，且自定义提供商 schema 无每模型能力字段。

top_pain_points.topic: 登出未清除管理员身份模拟状态，下一用户登录后所有请求携带 X-Act-As-User-Id 被 403 拒绝
top_pain_points.summary: 登出未清除管理员身份模拟状态，下一用户登录后所有请求携带 X-Act-As-User-Id 被 403 拒绝
top_pain_points.review_reason: 在共享浏览器/同一标签页场景下，管理员登出后再登录一个普通账号就会陷入全站 403、关键功能不可用的状态且无可见原因，需清除站点数据才能恢复——显著破坏可用性并造成困惑。

source_issues.title: Frontend: logout does not clear admin impersonation, so the next user to sign in sends X-Act-As-User-Id and gets 403 on every request
source_issues.evidence: logOut 不清 admin-impersonate-user-id sessionStorage 和非 httpOnly impersonation cookie，下一个在该浏览器登录的非管理员账号所有 /api/proxy 请求都带 X-Act-As-User-Id，后端返回 403，库、copilot 等全部无法加载

source_issues.title: Compaction deltas can revive cleared values when accumulated messages are replayed
source_issues.evidence: Accumulate 更新类型化 compaction 字符串，但 raw-JSON 刷新忽略空值；delta 将 content/encrypted_content 置 null 后，json.Marshal(ToParam()) 仍发送先前的字符串而非 null，类型化值、AsCompaction、RawJSON 与重放互相矛盾。

source_issues.title: Tool runner ignores additions and removals retained in compaction blocks
source_issues.evidence: 工具运行器 availableToolNames 忽略 assistant compaction 块中的 tool_changes；恢复含 tool_removal 的 compaction 块后，已移除的 weather 工具仍本地可执行，而 compacted 的重新添加不能恢复被系统消息移除的工具，流式与非流式运行器均受影响。

source_issues.title: Replayed preview starts erase completed managed-agent messages
source_issues.evidence: 已完成 agent.message 被同 ID 的 event_start 换成空 preview，过期 event_delta 覆盖其内容，span.model_request_end 删除该 preview；最终完整文本与原始字段从 AgentMessages 中丢失。可通过 SDK 客户端与 SSE 解析器复现。

source_issues.title: Partial compaction deltas erase accumulated summaries or encrypted metadata
source_issues.evidence: mergeCompactionDelta 把省略字段变成空 Optional 再转成显式 null，导致只含 content 的后续 delta 清除已建立的加密元数据，只含加密元数据的 delta 清除总结，省略两者时把缺失值转成显式 null。

source_issues.title: streaming: a later message_delta that omits stop_reason resets it to None (container is guarded, the stop_* fields are not)
source_issues.evidence: 第二个仅带 usage 的合法 message_delta 会把已设的 stop_reason 从 end_turn 重置为 None,且该重置通过 get_final_message() 对调用方可见;调用方读到 None 无法区分'流从未结束'。

source_issues.title: continue_conversation with a session_store continues a local session the store doesn't have
source_issues.evidence: repro: 两个 store 同一 cwd，Alice 先讲话，Bob 的 store 为空并请求 continue，结果 bob continued alice's session: True, bob got answer: PELICAN。即 Bob 继续了 Alice 的会话并拿到 secret word，Bob 的 store 还开始接收 Alice 会话。

source_issues.title: Python[Bug]: UserMessage drops session_id that the CLI sends on user messages
source_issues.evidence: parse_message() 漏掉 UserMessage 中的 session_id,导致无法识别工具结果属于哪个会话;TS SDK 支持但 Python 不支持。

source_issues.title: list_sessions() drops sessions whose first prompt is only an image or document
source_issues.evidence: repro 显示 image session 的 get_session_info 返回 None,list_sessions 遗漏它;TS SDK 会用 'Image'/'Document' 标注。空 summary 被当 metadata-only 丢弃。

source_issues.title: list_sessions() reports injected context like <system-reminder> as the session's first prompt
source_issues.evidence: repro: first_prompt 为 '<system-reminder>The user has app.py open.</system-reminder>',fork 标题也写入该文本;TS SDK 返回真实用户 prompt 'What is 2+2?'。

top_pain_points.topic: 关闭 OAuth2 IDP(OIDC)登录时授权请求无法到达 consent 页、循环跳回登录页
top_pain_points.summary: 启用 Auth 与 OAuth2 授权服务器、以 Google 为 OIDC IdP、用户尚未登录时,MCP 客户端的 /oauth2/authorize 授权请求经 Google 展示页面登录成功后因 cookie SameSite=Strict 跨站导航不携带,浏览器又跳回 /login 且无报错,每次重试循环,授权流程被阻断。
top_pain_points.review_reason: OAuth2/OIDC 授权服务器认证流程因 cookie 跨站问题循环失败,使用 MCP OAuth 授权的登录场景被完全阻断,影响认证与授权核心功能。

source_issues.title: [BUG]: OAuth2 authorize loops back to /login after IdP sign-in when the IdP shows a page
source_issues.evidence: browser lands back on /login after Google account chooser, 授权永不达 consent 页; 访问日志显示 /oauth2/authorize 302 后回 /login

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Self-hosted LOCAL_BACKEND_API_KEY is not exported to OH_SESSION_API_KEYS_0 in entrypoint.sh, causing agent-server auth bypass
source_issues.evidence: 当 self-hoster 用 LOCAL_BACKEND_API_KEY 自定义 key 时，export 语句被跳过，agent-server 以 config.session_api_keys=[] 启动，认证检查无条件通过，所有受保护 /api/* 路由可被未认证访问。triage 已确认真实。

source_issues.title: Cross-Organization Agent Scheduling Without Authorization Check
source_issues.evidence: attacker 组织 B 用户使用自己的 cookie 修改 agent_id 为组织 A 的 agent_id，请求仍返回 200 并生成 schedule_id；在受害者组织 A 的 agent 上出现攻击者安排的调度执行，证明跨组织越权调度成立。

source_issues.title: Cancelling one asynchronous token request cancels other callers sharing its refresh
source_issues.evidence: 异步令牌缓存把共享的 in-flight future 直接返回给所有等待同一刷新的调用者，取消其中一个 future 会影响其他调用者，后到的调用者可能拿到已取消的 future 并收到 CancellationException。

source_issues.title: Synchronous async-provider failures leave token-cache refresh futures unresolved
source_issues.evidence: provider 在返回 future 前抛出异常会绕过 completeAsync，预留的 future 保持未解决，后续调用者 join 一个未完成的 future 而永久挂起，强制刷新会令所有加入的调用者 pending。

source_issues.title: EnvironmentWorker cannot be created with the Client class from @anthropic-ai/aws-sdk
source_issues.evidence: AWS 的 Client 用 SigV4 签名鉴权、不设 authToken，导致 EnvironmentWorker 创建失败，需填 "dummy" 才能工作；open 状态、无修复。

source_issues.title: Synchronous token-provider failures bypass advisory recovery and refresh deduplication
source_issues.evidence: token provider 同步 throw 会绕过令牌缓存正常处理，仍可用的缓存 token 被忽略而错误拒绝，同时并发强制调用者各自独立调用失败的 provider。

source_issues.title: "Credit balance is too low" only via the action (Agent SDK); same key, runner and prompt work with claude -p
source_issues.evidence: 同一密钥/runner/二进制/prompt 下 claude -p 正常计费，仅 action(Agent SDK) 启动被拒报 Credit balance is too low；切片组织 service account + anthropic-workspace-id 场景受影响，主流程整步失败

source_issues.title: Auto mode classifier now blocks client work that clients explicitly authorized (regression since ~Sep 23, Opus 5.5)
source_issues.evidence: 外包工作室反复被阻：安装定时任务判为 Production Deploy、用客户提供的 key 调 API 判为 Credential Exploration、发送客户已付费的邮件判为 Real-World Transactions，均 'denial applies to the outcome'，用户言 'paid orders stop completely'。

top_pain_points.topic: 节点执行在恢复/重新派发时被重复计费（usage 计费非幂等）

source_issues.title: Node executions re-dispatched on resume (REVIEW/RUNNING) are charged credits again; usage charges are not idempotent
source_issues.evidence: 每个节点在派发前计 USAGE 且无幂等 key，暂停待审核的付费块批准后再次计费，同一个 node_exec_id 每个派发都产生一次 USAGE 交易，用户为暂停-恢复的流程付两次费用，执行次数计数器也重复累加

source_issues.title: [Bug] Weekly usage limit consumption rate increased ~3.6x after September 25 reset
source_issues.evidence: 12 条评论；周用量在 9.25 重置后消耗速率异常增加约 3.6 倍，无相应请求。

source_issues.title: [BUG] "Reset for free" (Opus 5.5 try-out) applied automatically when Max 20x → 5x downgrade took effect
source_issues.evidence: 降级生效时免费重置被自动触发，用户不等于主动选择，导致配额状态出人意料。

source_issues.title: [Bug] Usage limits weekly depleting faster than expected (Fable)
source_issues.evidence: 周用量在被高估的速率下消耗，计费与真实使用不一致。

source_issues.title: view_image 每次都重新注入全部看过的图片，没有张数和总字节预算，单次请求可达 300MB+
source_issues.evidence: 实测 view_image 后模型调用请求体 312,422,534 字节，23 秒后又 329,362,577 字节，每次约加一张高分辨率 PNG 的 base64；仅单张上限 20MiB，总张数/总字节无上限。

source_issues.title: Sessions marked failed keep consuming for 20+ hours; FREE-labeled models bill credits; ~183k input tokens per call
source_issues.evidence: 10个非Anthropic会话中9个 failed 仍持续消耗，单个 deepseek-v4-pro 会话 416 次调用消耗 112,057,985 输入token；Cline Credits 余额 -0.26USD，FREE 标签模型被扣费导致 web_search 返回 402 insufficient_credits。

source_issues.title: Streamed run keeps calling the model and tools after its only stream_events() consumer stops outside the queue wait
source_issues.evidence: 复现输出: raise in loop body: tool calls at exit=1, 1s later=20, run done=False; cancel in loop body: 1s later=19; 消费者停止后 run 继续做了其余全部工具调用,每个模型调用都被计费,0.22.3/0.24.0/main 一致复现

source_issues.title: Streaming helpers re-parse the whole accumulated JSON on every delta (quadratic in output size)
source_issues.evidence: 每个 delta 对完整累计 content/arguments 重新 partial 解析,并给出不同大小下 from_json 耗时表(4KB/20KB/70KB 分别约 0.7/12.6/141ms),对大型结构化输出或工具调用构成二次复杂度。

signals.review_reason: 用户在升级 Ubuntu 25.04 后使用官方推荐的 pipx 方式安装 aider-chat，因 numpy 构建 wheel 时仍返回 BackendUnavailable 无法导入 setuptools.build_meta 而报 Fatal error 中止，导致核心工具无法安装、首次使用即失败。虽 count=1 且单仓，但属明确的主流程阻断即安装失败，非纯功能请求或维护事项。

source_issues.title: Can't install on Ubuntu 25.04 with Python 3.13 and pipx
source_issues.evidence: Ubuntu 25.04, Python 3.13, pipx install aider-chat 报 Fatal error, pip 尝试构建 numpy==1.24.3 wheel, BackendUnavailable: Cannot import setuptools.build_meta, 安装中止, 6 评论

signals.topic: 使用 Anthropic 模型的评估器在设置 temperature/top_p/top_k 后每次调用都崩溃
signals.summary: phoenix-evals 的 AnthropicAdapter 将评估器调用参数原样转发给 client.messages.create(),而 anthropic>=1 已从签名移除这些参数,导致使用 Anthropic LLM 并设置 temperature 的评估器每次调用都抛 TypeError,连文档示例用法也触发,覆盖 generate_text/generate_object 及 async 版本,该配置下的评估功能完全不可用。
signals.review_reason: 按文档示例设置 temperature 即导致评估器每次调用崩溃抛异常,Anthropic 提供商的评估关键功能在该配置下不可用,有明确复现,直接影响用户评估工作流。

source_issues.title: [BUG] phoenix-evals: Anthropic evaluators fail with temperature/top_p/top_k (anthropic>=1 removed them from messages.create)
source_issues.evidence: TypeError: Messages.create() got an unexpected keyword argument 'temperature'; 复现 CorrectnessEvaluator(llm=llm, temperature=0.0).evaluate(data) 抛 TypeError 而无 temperature 时正常

signals.topic: 实验对比页面在大数据集下因 SQL 未分页而持续超时挂起
signals.summary: 打开 /datasets/<id>/experiments 页面时 compareExperiments GraphQL 查询运行时间超过 60 秒空闲超时被断开连接而挂起。用户确认 CPU/内存/IOPS 均有余量,是单纯等待一个长 SQL 查询;数据集不断增长使加载时间无上限增长,用户只能临时调高 ALB 超时作为权宜之计。
signals.review_reason: 实验对比是 Phoenix 核心功能,大数据集下页面直接挂起无法使用,用户工作流被阻断,且随数据增长问题持续恶化。

source_issues.title: [BUG]: experiments page times out on large datasets - compareExperiments SQL isn't paginated
source_issues.evidence: compute page just hangs; compareExperiments GraphQL runs longer than LB 60s idle timeout; app/DB idle, time spent on one long query

signals.topic: Playground 对 AWS Bedrock 处理工具结果消息时因非 JSON 文本崩溃
signals.summary: playground 运行 AWS Bedrock 模型时,BedrockClient._build_converse_messages 把所有工具结果强制 json.loads,当工具输出是普通文本(如 '72 degrees and sunny')时请求序列化前即抛 JSONDecodeError,运行立即失败,而 OpenAI/Anthropic 客户端都按文本透传。
signals.review_reason: playground 运行 Bedrock 模型且提示含工具消息(工具输出的常规场景)时每次运行立即崩溃,关键功能不可用。

source_issues.title: [BUG]: [playground] AWS Bedrock run crashes with JSONDecodeError when a tool result message contains plain text
source_issues.evidence: json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Extra data line 1 column 4 (char 3); 工具结果为普通文本时 BedrockClient 在请求前 json.loads 崩溃

signals.topic: 在线评估(online evals)无法保存项目级评估器
signals.summary: 在线评估功能中用户尝试保存项目评估器(project evaluators)失败,整个保存操作不可用,影响在线评估工作流的配置环节。
signals.review_reason: 在线评估是重点功能,项目评估器保存失败会阻断该配置流程,但本 issue 证据仅截图、缺字段详情,置信度降低。

source_issues.title: [online evals] [bug] Cannot save project evaluators
source_issues.evidence: 无法保存 project evaluators(附报错截图)

signals.topic: 关闭 OAuth2 IDP(OIDC)登录时授权请求无法到达 consent 页、循环跳回登录页
signals.summary: 启用 Auth 与 OAuth2 授权服务器、以 Google 为 OIDC IdP、用户尚未登录时,MCP 客户端的 /oauth2/authorize 授权请求经 Google 展示页面登录成功后因 cookie SameSite=Strict 跨站导航不携带,浏览器又跳回 /login 且无报错,每次重试循环,授权流程被阻断。
signals.review_reason: OAuth2/OIDC 授权服务器认证流程因 cookie 跨站问题循环失败,使用 MCP OAuth 授权的登录场景被完全阻断,影响认证与授权核心功能。

source_issues.title: [BUG]: OAuth2 authorize loops back to /login after IdP sign-in when the IdP shows a page
source_issues.evidence: browser lands back on /login after Google account chooser, 授权永不达 consent 页; 访问日志显示 /oauth2/authorize 302 后回 /login

signals.topic: 发送消息后 LLM 运行失败但用户看不到任何报错/回复，主对话流程静默阻断
signals.summary: 用户发送消息后，LLM/工具运行失败但前端不展示错误详情：运行失败横幅在刷新后消失、LLM 错误仅出现在服务端日志而 UI 只显示泛化 error、依赖缺失导致无回复。结果表现为 agent 静默忽略请求，用户无法得知失败原因。
signals.review_reason: 这是主对话流程的核心用户路径失败：用户发送消息(核心主流程)后可能得不到任何回复和任何可见报错，agent 看似静默忽视消息，用户既无法得知失败原因也无法修复配置，直接阻断核心功能使用，证据充分。由于主要为同一项目的运行反馈缺失问题，count=3，涉及多个不同根因但共享'用户对失败无感知'痛点，非纯单仓边缘项，但尚未构成高频系统性崩溃，故判 P1。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Run-failure banner disappears after reload (error invisible, user message left unanswered)
source_issues.evidence: 运行以 LLM/tool 失败结束时，失败横幅仅存在于内存 store（useErrorMessageStore），页面刷新后失败不可见，用户消息留在会话里无回复无报错，读起来像 agent 静默忽略请求；移动端频繁 tab 恢复受影响最大。可见 ConversationErrorEvent 但 UI 无任何 error-message-banner。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: LLM errors not propagated to the frontend
source_issues.evidence: 用户用 Nebius 时模型不存在(404)，错误只在服务端日志出现，UI 只显示 error 而无错误详情，用户无法排查。

signals.topic: 编辑 LLM Profile 仅改模型就会清空已存 API Key，导致切换 profile 后认证失败
signals.summary: 用户在设置页只改 LLM 模型、不重输 API key 保存时，前端把空的 api_key 字符串作为覆盖值转发后端并持久化，导致 mid-conversation 用模型 combobox 切换 profile 时报认证错误(必须提供 API key)。
signals.review_reason: 用户合法操作(仅切换模型)会意外清空凭据并导致后续消息认证失败，主对话流程被打断且难以自查(字段未填充秘密导致每次保存都可能复现)，是明确的用户体验与认证功能受损。单仓单issue，count=1，按规则不升 P0，判 P1。

signals.topic: 托管 Canvas 新建会话持续失败（沙箱缺失插件 schema），新会话无法启动
signals.summary: 在托管 Canvas(app.all-hands.dev)上新建任何会话都会 500 失败，因为沙箱镜像缺少 plugin format schema，启动卡在 SETTING_UP_SKILLS 后 error，永远不会产出 app_conversation_id；已有会话不受影响。
signals.review_reason: 托管环境中核心入口(新建会话)完全失败，功能不可用，属启动崩溃，用户影响直接且严重。虽 count=1 单仓，因是 P0 严重性级别的完全功能不可用，但规则要求 count<3 不默认 P0，故判 P1。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Creating a conversation always fails: the sandbox agent cannot find the plugin schema.
source_issues.evidence: 新建会话启动卡在 SETTING_UP_SKILLS 然后 500，因沙箱 bundle 缺少 openhands/sdk/plugin/format/schemas/plugin-1.0.0.schema.json；通过 API 同样 500，无 app_conversation_id。对所有新会话完全失败。

signals.topic: 自托管升级后 automation 数据库迁移失败，automation 服务静默崩溃不可用
signals.summary: openhands-automation 升级时 SQLite 迁移 028->029 因列已存在而失败并退出(exit 3)，服务无法自恢复，Agent Canvas 对所有 /api/automation 请求返回 ECONNREFUSED；且启动脚本不硬失败，用户难以察觉服务已死。
signals.review_reason: 自托管用户在升级后核心 automation 功能不可用，服务反复启动失败且无清晰失败提示(用户需自行察觉服务未运行)，是阻断型故障。count=1 单仓，按规则判 P1。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: migration 029 errors with `duplicate column name: consecutive_auth_failures` on SQLite
source_issues.evidence: HUMAN 报告：迁移失败静默杀死了 automation server，用户升级后没注意到服务没在跑，需借助 agent 调试；每次重启都同样失败，automation 接口全部 ECONNREFUSED。

signals.topic: 自托管自定义 LOCAL_BACKEND_API_KEY 未映射到 agent-server，导致 agent 服务认证绕过
signals.summary: 自托管用户配置 LOCAL_BACKEND_API_KEY 后，entrypoint.sh 仅在无 key 分支导出 OH_SESSION_API_KEYS_0，导致 agent-server 的 session_api_keys 为空，所有 /api/* 受保护路由(包括 bash、files、conversations、settings)绕过认证允许任何人执行操作。
signals.review_reason: 自托管用户按文档配置自定义 key 后，agent 服务实际完全未加认证，任何能访问该端口的人都能执行操作、读取会话和文件，属安全/权限关键缺陷。单仓 count=1，判 P1。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Self-hosted LOCAL_BACKEND_API_KEY is not exported to OH_SESSION_API_KEYS_0 in entrypoint.sh, causing agent-server auth bypass
source_issues.evidence: 当 self-hoster 用 LOCAL_BACKEND_API_KEY 自定义 key 时，export 语句被跳过，agent-server 以 config.session_api_keys=[] 启动，认证检查无条件通过，所有受保护 /api/* 路由可被未认证访问。triage 已确认真实。

signals.topic: 节点执行失败/挂起后无有用错误信息且连接泄漏（SendDiscordMessageBlock 抛异常时永不返回，挂起到块超时）
signals.summary: SendDiscordMessageBlock 在 channel.send 失败时永不返回，节点挂起到默认30分钟块超时，仅服务端日志记录，用户得不到可见错误且泄漏 bot 网关连接
signals.review_reason: 常见且典型的误配置（缺少 Send Messages 权限）导致节点执行挂起长达 30 分钟，同时泄漏 bot 网关连接，用户只得到一个无有用错误的超时，而非立即可见的失败——直接造成主流程阻断与体验显著下降。

source_issues.title: SendDiscordMessageBlock hangs until block timeout when channel.send fails (exception in on_ready handler never closes the client)
source_issues.evidence: on_ready 处理器内无 try/finally，channel.send 抛 Forbidden/HTTPException 时被 discord.py 吞掉，client.close() 永不执行，block 挂起直到默认 30 分钟超时，唯一可见记录是服务端日志行，用户看不到任何错误

signals.topic: 人工审核后恢复执行时丢失执行上下文，导致已拒绝的不可逆操作仍被执行、后续节点跳过复核、媒体/文件块失败
signals.summary: 人工审核后恢复执行时丢失执行上下文，已拒绝的不可逆操作仍被执行、后续节点跳过复核、媒体/文件块失败
signals.review_reason: 这是安全模式(sensitive-action safe mode)的关键失败：用户在审核界面明确拒绝/编辑后，被拒的发布/发送/删除操作仍然执行，属于安全保证被击穿，并连带破坏所有依赖文件/媒体的块；造成不可逆动作实际执行和流程错误的双重用户影响。

source_issues.title: Resuming after a human review rebuilds ExecutionContext without graph_exec_id/user_id: rejected irreversible actions still run, later ones skip review, media blocks fail
source_issues.evidence: 恢复时构建的 ExecutionContext 无 user_id/graph_id/graph_exec_id，_execute 仅在 graph_exec_id 非空时才做敏感操作复核，导致被拒绝的不可逆动作照常执行、后续不可逆块不再暂停、store_media_file 等抛出 ValueError: execution_context.graph_exec_id is required

signals.topic: 节点执行在恢复/重新派发时被重复计费（usage 计费非幂等）
signals.summary: 节点执行在恢复/重新派发时被重复计费（usage 计费非幂等）
signals.review_reason: 直接导致用户被重复扣减积分/费用，是明确的计费异常与成本损失；在安全模式暂停与人工审核、以及执行器崩溃后重跑这些受支持流程中均可复现。

source_issues.title: Node executions re-dispatched on resume (REVIEW/RUNNING) are charged credits again; usage charges are not idempotent
source_issues.evidence: 每个节点在派发前计 USAGE 且无幂等 key，暂停待审核的付费块批准后再次计费，同一个 node_exec_id 每个派发都产生一次 USAGE 交易，用户为暂停-恢复的流程付两次费用，执行次数计数器也重复累加

signals.topic: 管理员对卡住 QUEUED 执行的重发是静默空操作（报告成功但实际未发布）
signals.summary: 管理员对卡住 QUEUED 执行的重发是静默空操作（报告成功但实际未发布）
signals.review_reason: 这是唯一内置的卡住执行恢复手段，却始终报告成功但什么都不做，导致卡死运行无法被恢复且管理员以为已处理；虽然仅限管理员，但失败完全不可见，用户(管理员)在关键恢复场景被误导。

source_issues.title: Admin requeue of stuck QUEUED executions is a silent no-op (QUEUED->QUEUED rejected, nothing published, success returned)
source_issues.evidence: 三个管理员重发端点筛选 QUEUED 后调用 add_graph_execution，但 VALID_STATUS_TRANSITIONS 不允许 QUEUED->QUEUED，导致写更新不匹配、发布被跳过，而接口仍返回 success:true/requeued_count>=1，执行保持卡死

signals.topic: 登出未清除管理员身份模拟状态，下一用户登录后所有请求携带 X-Act-As-User-Id 被 403 拒绝
signals.summary: 登出未清除管理员身份模拟状态，下一用户登录后所有请求携带 X-Act-As-User-Id 被 403 拒绝
signals.review_reason: 在共享浏览器/同一标签页场景下，管理员登出后再登录一个普通账号就会陷入全站 403、关键功能不可用的状态且无可见原因，需清除站点数据才能恢复——显著破坏可用性并造成困惑。

source_issues.title: Frontend: logout does not clear admin impersonation, so the next user to sign in sends X-Act-As-User-Id and gets 403 on every request
source_issues.evidence: logOut 不清 admin-impersonate-user-id sessionStorage 和非 httpOnly impersonation cookie，下一个在该浏览器登录的非管理员账号所有 /api/proxy 请求都带 X-Act-As-User-Id，后端返回 403，库、copilot 等全部无法加载

signals.topic: 跨组织越权调度 Agent：多租户隔离失效导致他组织可控制本组织 Agent
signals.summary: SuperAGI 的 /api/agentexecutions/schedule 端点在调度已存在的 agent 时只校验用户认证但未校验 agent 所属组织，导致任意一个已登录组织的用户只需替换 agent_id 即可调度属于其他组织的 agent，破坏多租户隔离。
signals.review_reason: 这是可复现的越权访问控制漏洞（CWE-284），多租户场景下组织 B 用户可未经授权调度组织 A 的 agent，导致其他租户的 agent 执行调度被外部控制篡改，属于多租户隔离被破坏的安全痛点，直接威胁用户的数据与执行控制权。虽仅有单条 issue 且单仓涉及，但复现步骤给出明确的用户受�12 场景，故保留为 P1 而非纯安全公告排除。

source_issues.title: Cross-Organization Agent Scheduling Without Authorization Check
source_issues.evidence: attacker 组织 B 用户使用自己的 cookie 修改 agent_id 为组织 A 的 agent_id，请求仍返回 200 并生成 schedule_id；在受害者组织 A 的 agent 上出现攻击者安排的调度执行，证明跨组织越权调度成立。

signals.topic: 自定义/第三方多模态提供商的图像输入被静默丢弃（vision 能力按原始提供商名匹配，导致自定义镜像提供商、聊天大户、Moonshot/本地模型等即使声明支持视觉也会丢失图像）
signals.summary: Goose 的视觉能力解析按键在静态规范提供商名而非 catalog_provider_id 或每模型能力标志，导致自定义提供商（镜像知名服务）、非规范命名提供商及部分内置提供商（Moonshot kimi-k3、chatgpt_codex 等）在模型实为多模态时静默丢弃图像附件/工具结果图像，回复 [image omitted: model does not support vision]，模型永远收不到图像，多模态核心功能不可用。
signals.review_reason: 多模态视觉是用户可感知的核心能力，多个提供商（自定义镜像、非规范命名、内置 Moonshot/chatgpt_codex）在模型实为多模态时静默丢弃图像，模型永远收不到输入导致功能完全不可用，且是静默失败无报错，用户难以察觉原因。count>=6，跨多条不同提供商路径相互印证同一根因（视觉能力解析与提供商能力元数据缺陷），属主功能阻断。

source_issues.title: Custom provider mirroring a known provider silently loses vision support (vision lookup is keyed on the raw provider name
source_issues.evidence: 自定义提供商 (fireworks-live, engine:openai) 指向知名后端时所有图像输入被静默丢弃，即使 goose 自身将该模型列为 supports_vision。图像被本地替换为占位文本，从未发送给模型。改为规范名即恢复视觉。根因:模型能力解析按键并在 (provider_name, model_name)，catalog_provider_id 未用于运行时视觉解析，且自定义提供商 schema 无每模型能力字段。

source_issues.title: custom providers images dropped even with supports_vision true
source_issues.evidence: 透过 Strata 引擎使用自定义提供商时，即使模型 JSON 声明 supports_vision/vision:true 且更换 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容引擎，图像仍被替换为 [image omitted]，image_url 内容块从未转发给上游。同一 goose 版本连 Project Maya (GLM-5.3-Flash) 视觉正常，说明视觉检查只匹配静态规范目录而忽略自定义 provider 的 supports_vision。

source_issues.title: Tool-result images are sent as an image-only user message; some OpenAI-compatible gateways ignore it
source_issues.evidence: 视觉解析正确 (supports_vision=true) 且图像确实在请求中时，goose 把工具结果图像作为仅含 image_url 的独立 user 消息发送，某些 OpenAI 兼容网关不处理该形态——模型报告未收到图像或凭空幻觉无关内容。形状矩阵对比显示加任意文本部分即恢复正确，证明是消息形态问题导致图像丢失。

source_issues.title: chatgpt_codex: images in tool results are dropped
source_issues.evidence: chatgpt_codex 提供商 build_input_items 中只保留 ContentBlock::Text，图像块（如 read_image 结果）被跳过，模型永远看不到工具结果中的图像。用户附件图像正常，工具结果图像丢失。

source_issues.title: Moonshot provider images dropped for kimi-k3 despite native vision
source_issues.evidence: Moonshot 提供商 + kimi-k3 时 goose 拒绝发送图像附件，回复 [image omitted]，而 kimi-k3 原生多模态（Moonshot 模型卡与 OpenRouter 均列为支持图像）。能力元数据错误，且切换 Alibaba/qwen 即正常，说明是提供商能力声明缺陷。

signals.topic: 图像参与的并行工具调用批量产生无效载荷，使会话被永久锁死无法恢复
signals.summary: 使用支持视觉的 OpenAI 兼容提供商时，若单个 assistant 回合并行批量调用两个以上工具且其中一个返回图像，goose 把图像悬浮为插入其中的独立 user 消息，破坏 tool 消息连续性，API 返回 400；该错误配对被持久化，之后每个请求都失败，会话被永久锁死，只能手工编辑会话数据库恢复。
signals.review_reason: 该缺陷把整个会话推向永久不可用状态且无应用内恢复手段，属于关键功能不可用级别。虽 count=1 且为单仓问题，但影响为中断性会话锁死而非边缘改进，故保留并标 P1（按规则 count<3 不升 P0）。

source_issues.title: OpenAI-compatible providers: image-bearing tool result in a parallel tool batch produces an invalid payload (400) and permanently bricks the session
source_issues.evidence: 配置 supports_vision:true 的 OpenAI 兼容提供商，单回合并行两个工具且其一返回图像时，goose 将图像提升为独立的 user 消息并插入 tool 消息运行中间，破坏 'assistant tool_calls 后必须紧跟对应 tool 消息' 的约束，API 400。坏配对被持久化，之后每个请求都 400，所有重试耗尽，会话永久不可用，只能删除会话 DB 中的坏消息对恢复。

signals.topic: 本地提供商（如 Ollama）完全停机时，发送消息后界面卡在 in-flight 状态约 2 分钟才报错，且网络错误被当作可重试错误进入长退避
signals.summary: 连接被拒绝（本地提供商服务已停止、端口无人监听）被映射为 NetworkError 并归类为可重试错误，叠加 Ollama 专为大模型加载预留的冗长退避预算，导致用户在大概率永久失败的条件下盯着'正在工作中'指示器等约 2 分钟才看到无法连接的错误。
signals.review_reason: 用户在主流程中面对失败条件时 UI 长时间无反馈、延迟约 2 分钟才得到错误，明显拉低体验;虽为单仓单条且非阻断(最终报错正确)，属典型错误反馈与重试策略 bug，保留标 P2。

source_issues.title: Ensure all retryable provider errors are retried with backoff and UI feedback
source_issues.evidence: Ollama 服务完全停止时发送消息，聊天停留在 'working' 指示器约 2 分钟才显示 Could not connect 网络错误。直接 curl 立即拒绝，延迟全部来自 goose 重试逻辑:connection-refused 被 is_connect() 映射为 NetworkError，而 NetworkError 被归类为 retryable，叠加 Ollama 的 OLLAMA_MAX_RETRIES=10、退避到 15s 的预算，约 100 秒。应向对永久性失败的本地连接快速失败。

signals.topic: 工具错误序列化往返不保真导致提示缓存失效，长上下文会话被迫每轮重做整个 prefill 而大幅变慢
signals.summary: MCP 或多代理工具结果的失败被序列化为错误字符串再反序列化时丢失错误码(-32002 变成 -32603 并不断累积前缀)，导致历史工具响应内容在用户仅追加新消息时也改变，前缀提示缓存失效，短跟进就触发接近全量的长上下文重填，200K 上下文 + 慢速本地模型下每轮重建缓存而显著变慢。
signals.review_reason: 缓存失效迫使长上下文会话每轮重做整段 prefill，严重拖慢慢速本地模型工作流并增加推理成本，用户可感知明显性能与成本损失;虽单仓单条，属真实主流程性能痛点，保留标 P2。

source_issues.title: Goose unnecessarily invalidates cache that results in redoing entire prefill
source_issues.evidence: goose 每轮结束都会因工具结果序列化不保真而失效缓存，需重做大部分 prefill；工具调用期间的不必要摘要也会多次重建缓存。根因是 ToolResult 序列化只存格式化的错误字符串，反序列化无条件用 -32603，往返后错误码与内容变化，触发前缀缓存失效。对比两次连续请求负载证实短跟进引发接近完整长上下文重填。

signals.topic: 工作流(Workflow)在非流式模式与容器步骤(Parallel/Steps/Loop/Condition/Router)下错误处理与媒体传递失效
signals.summary: Workflow 在非流式模式下 Agent/Team 步骤失败不会使工作流失败(重试与 skip_on_failure 被忽略、Loop 继续迭代、on_error 不触发),同时容器步骤会静默丢弃成员步骤产生的 File 媒体、合并步骤内的 human_review 暂停完全失效、异步流式工作流会把完成的步骤执行为 CANCELLED
signals.review_reason: 同一工作流框架存在多类用户可感知的静默失效:非流式模式下步骤失败被吞掉导致报告误标 COMPLETED、容器内生成的文件被静默丢弃、容器内的人工审核被静默绕过、完成后任务被错误标记为取消。这些都会导致关键流程产出丢失或错误,直接影响用户体验与结果可信度

source_issues.title: A failed Agent/Team step doesn't fail a non-streamed workflow: no retries, skip_on_failure ignored, Loop and Steps carry on
source_issues.evidence: 非流式运行时失败的 Agent 步骤返回 StepOutput(success=False) 而不抛异常,重试和 skip_on_failure 从不生效,Loop 继续迭代、Steps 继续运行后续步骤、Condition 的 on_error 永不触发;同一工作流流式时会重试并停止,非流式时则照常跑完并报告 COMPLETED,用户无法感知步骤失败

source_issues.title: Workflow container steps (Parallel/Steps/Loop/Condition/Router) silently drop File media produced by their member steps
source_issues.evidence: Parallel._aggregate_results 与四个 _update_step_input_from_outputs 均遗漏 files 字段(Image/Video/Audio 都正常),容器内步骤生成的 File 既不会传给下一步也不会出现在最终 run_response.files 中,用户产出的文件被静默丢弃

source_issues.title: human_review on a Step inside Condition, Loop, Parallel, Steps or Router never pauses the workflow
source_issues.evidence: human_review/requires_confirmation 只作用于顶层工作流,放在任意容器内部时暂停检查从未被调用,下一步直接运行、无需任何审核,绕过人工审批,复现显示 top level 暂停而所有容器路径不暂停

source_issues.title: Async streamed workflows store each completed Agent/Team step's executor run as CANCELLED
source_issues.evidence: Step.aexecute_stream 用 break 退出 executor 生成器,触发 GeneratorExit 被当成客户端断开,把刚完成的 run 标为 cancelled 并持久化,100ms 后 status 由 COMPLETED 变为 CANCELLED,运行记录与遥测被错误改写

signals.topic: MCP 工具适配导致数据损坏或错误详情丢失
signals.summary: Go 版 MCP 适配器在工具调用链中丢失或破坏数据：结构化的错误诊断（structuredContent）被丢弃为通用错误；数字参数经 float64 转换后精度丢失/越界；媒体资源因 MIME 类型匹配过于字面而被拒绝或跳过。用户在真实 MCP 工具调用中会收到失真的参数或无法获得诊断信息。
signals.review_reason: 用户在通过 MCP 适配器调用工具或转换资源时，会收到被破坏的数值参数、被丢弃的错误诊断、被拒绝或错乱的资源内容，直接影响工具调用的正确性和可调试性，属于主流程运行期数据损坏。

source_issues.title: MCP adapter discards structured-only error details
source_issues.evidence: CallToolResult 返回 IsError:true、内容为空、StructuredContent 含诊断信息时，mcp.NewBetaTool 仅返回通用错误 'tool returned an error'，结构化诊断载荷丢失；IsError 为 false 时却能正确转换。可复现。

source_issues.title: MCP tool forwarding rounds numeric arguments before the server receives them
source_issues.evidence: NewBetaTool.Execute 将模型 JSON 解码为 map[string]any 经 float64 转换，9007199254740993 被舍入为 9007199254740992，嵌套/数组同样受影响，1e400 在本地失败，损坏传递给 MCP 服务端的参数。

source_issues.title: MCP content conversion rejects equivalent media types and skips supported resources
source_issues.evidence: MCP 图片/资源转换对 MIME 字符串字面比较，IMAGE/PNG 或带 charset=binary 后缀的类型被拒绝；大小写差异或参数后缀导致首个受支持资源被跳过而返回后面的文本资源，影响嵌入式 PDF 和文本资源。

signals.topic: SSE 流式事件丢失导致首条消息/错误不可达
signals.summary: SDK 的 SSE 解码器在解析时丢失数据：响应的首个 UTF-8 BOM 被当作字段名导致首条 message_start 或 error 事件丢失（报错场景甚至返回 nil 错误）；仅用 CR 换行的 SSE 流完全不产生事件，混合换行结尾会合并 JSON 载荷并解析失败。用户无法收到流式首条消息或服务端错误。
signals.review_reason: 用户与使用 SSE 的端点交互时，首条流式消息或服务端错误被静默丢弃（报错时甚至返回 nil 错误、无法感知失败），直接影响流式调用的可靠性和失败可见性，属于关键功能不可用的主流程问题。

source_issues.title: A leading UTF-8 BOM hides the first streamed message event or error
source_issues.evidence: 以 ﻿event: message_start 开头的响应丢失该事件，以 ﻿event: error 开头的响应不报告服务端错误并返回 nil 流错误而非类型化 API 错误；GA 和 beta 客户端均复现。

source_issues.title: SSE decoding drops CR-only streams and can merge events with mixed line endings
source_issues.evidence: 默认解码器用 bufio.Scanner 普通行切分，不识别单独 CR，CR 分隔的合法 SSE 流不产生任何事件；混合换行结尾会合并 JSON 载荷并解析失败。

signals.topic: 回退链路的状态与取消/超时错误处理不正确
signals.summary: Beta 回退（fallback）机制在失败场景下行为错误：失败的候选请求会把最后成功路由替换掉，导致后续请求被钉在从未成功过的模型上；流式回退把 context 取消/超时当作普通不可达模型并合成成功的流完成，吞掉取消/超时错误。用户在多模型回退场景下会得到错误的模型路由或丢失取消语义。
signals.review_reason: 用户依赖回退机制保证可用性和正确路由，但失败请求会污染路由状态导致后续请求走错模型，且请求取消/超时被吞掉并合成成功响应，直接破坏取消语义与多模型容错的可信度，属于运行期关键错误处理缺陷。

source_issues.title: Failed fallback attempts replace the last successful conversation route
source_issues.evidence: BetaFallbackState 文档承诺保持在接受的模型上，但两条回退路径都在发送候选请求前设置索引；回退拒绝、HTTP/传输错误或流未完成都会替换先前路由，后续请求被钉在从未接受的 fallback 上。Go 端对应 typescript#1252。

source_issues.title: Streaming refusal fallback swallows cancellation and deadline errors
source_issues.evidence: 流式回退的 tryHop 对 send 的一切错误返回 (nil,nil)，包括包装的 context.Canceled 和 context.DeadlineExceeded；链可能尝试下一模型或合成成功完成，stream.Err() 为 nil，取消/超时被吞掉。

signals.topic: compaction 重放导致已清除值复活或工具集合不一致
signals.summary: Beta compaction 相关逻辑在重放历史时状态不一致：compaction delta 将字段置 null/空后，后续 raw-JSON 刷新忽略空值导致先前 summary/encrypted_content 复活并随 ToParam 发送；工具运行器忽略 assistant compaction 块中的 tool_changes，导致已移除工具仍可本地执行、重新添加不被恢复。
signals.review_reason: 用户在会话/工具状态回放场景中会遭遇数据不一致：已清除的上下文内容被错误发送，或已移除的工具仍被本地执行导致工具调度错误，直接影响状态一致性与工具调用的正确性。

source_issues.title: Compaction deltas can revive cleared values when accumulated messages are replayed
source_issues.evidence: Accumulate 更新类型化 compaction 字符串，但 raw-JSON 刷新忽略空值；delta 将 content/encrypted_content 置 null 后，json.Marshal(ToParam()) 仍发送先前的字符串而非 null，类型化值、AsCompaction、RawJSON 与重放互相矛盾。

source_issues.title: Tool runner ignores additions and removals retained in compaction blocks
source_issues.evidence: 工具运行器 availableToolNames 忽略 assistant compaction 块中的 tool_changes；恢复含 tool_removal 的 compaction 块后，已移除的 weather 工具仍本地可执行，而 compacted 的重新添加不能恢复被系统消息移除的工具，流式与非流式运行器均受影响。

signals.topic: 重放 preview 覆盖已完成的 agent.message 导致消息丢失
signals.summary: 对已完成 agent.message 的重新 event_start 会用空 preview 替换已完成消息，过期的 event_delta 随后覆盖其内容，span.model_request_end 还会删除重开的 preview，导致完整消息文本与原始字段彻底消失。
signals.review_reason: 连接/重放等场景下，用户已经完成的 agent 消息内容会被空 preview 和过期增量覆盖并最终删除，导致会话历史数据永久丢失，属于真实的关键数据丢失缺陷，但仅单仓单项、影响面相对窄。

source_issues.title: Replayed preview starts erase completed managed-agent messages
source_issues.evidence: 已完成 agent.message 被同 ID 的 event_start 换成空 preview，过期 event_delta 覆盖其内容，span.model_request_end 删除该 preview；最终完整文本与原始字段从 AgentMessages 中丢失。可通过 SDK 客户端与 SSE 解析器复现。

signals.topic: MCP 工具适配丢失诊断/数据信息：错误负载丢失、additionalProperties 约束被丢弃、数值精度被双精度转换破坏
signals.summary: MCP 工具适配丢失诊断/数据信息：错误负载丢失、additionalProperties 约束被丢弃、数值精度被双精度转换破坏。
signals.review_reason: 三个 MCP 工具适配问题都会造成用户可见的数据/信息丢失：错误诊断 payload 为空使得排障失效，数值被舍入/溢出导致传入工具的参数错误，schema 约束丢失可能使工具校验行为不符预期。虽分散在三个具体点，但同属 MCP 工具转换链路信息丢失，合并为 P1。

source_issues.title: MCP tool errors with only structuredContent lose their diagnostic payload
source_issues.evidence: 当 CallToolResult 只有 structuredContent 且 isError=true 时，异常消息只从 content 构建，诊断负载丢失，抛出空消息的 AnthropicException，而同样的 payload 在 isError=false 时能作为 JSON 保留。

source_issues.title: MCP tool conversion drops explicit additionalProperties restrictions
source_issues.evidence: BetaMcp.mcpTool 转换 JsonSchema 时遗漏 additionalProperties 字段，'additionalProperties':false 被丢弃，转换后的 schema 允许源 schema 禁止的未声明属性。

source_issues.title: MCP tool input conversion rounds decimals and overflows or underflows exponents
source_issues.evidence: MCP 工具输入 JSON 参数经默认 Jackson 转成 Double，小数被取整、大整数溢出、1e400 变 Infinity，数值精度在到达 MCP 客户端前被二进制浮点转换破坏。

signals.topic: 异步流式请求在线程/执行器选择上失控，破坏调用方的 Context 传播（MDC、OpenTelemetry span、Micrometer Observation），且无法配置
signals.summary: 异步流式请求在线程/执行器选择上失控，破坏调用方的 Context 传播（MDC、OpenTelemetry span、Micrometer Observation），且无法配置执行器，导致可观测性失效。
signals.review_reason: 两个 issue 都是异步流式场景执行器/线程行为缺陷：用户在做可观测性或 trace 追踪时，流式请求无法与主 trace 关联，且 executor 被拒绝会导致响应悬挂不关闭、主流程挂起。虽合并 count 达 2 但分布在两个不同子主题(接线线程选择 vs executor 拒绝处理)，非单一直观痛点，标 P1。

source_issues.title: Async streaming requests run on ForkJoinPool.commonPool (thenComposeAsync without executor); no way to supply an executor, breaks trace-context propagation
source_issues.evidence: 异步流式路径用不带 executor 的 thenComposeAsync，请求构建和 enqueue 在 ForkJoinPool.commonPool 上执行，线程局部变量丢失，每个流式请求开启新的根 trace 并发送与调用方无关的 traceparent，且公开 API 无法提供 executor。

source_issues.title: A rejected streaming executor leaves completion pending and the response open
source_issues.evidence: 当异步流式响应的回调执行器被拒绝(rejected executor)时，onCompleteFuture 永不 settle，返回的响应一直保持 open，toAsync 丢弃了记录拒绝的 future，正常清理逻辑不执行。

signals.topic: 异步令牌缓存刷新在取消/异常场景下错误传播，导致共享请求的其他调用者收到 CancellationException 或永久挂起
signals.summary: 异步令牌缓存刷新在取消/异常场景下错误传播，导致共享请求的其他调用者收到 CancellationException 或永久挂起，认证请求失败或卡死。
signals.review_reason: 令牌刷新是异步调用的关键前置步骤，无论是取消传播到一个调用者导致其他调用者认证失败，还是 provider 失败导致所有调用者永久挂起，都是可导致请求失败或卡死的真实用户痛点。分属取消传播与异常未解决两个变体，合并标 P1。

source_issues.title: Cancelling one asynchronous token request cancels other callers sharing its refresh
source_issues.evidence: 异步令牌缓存把共享的 in-flight future 直接返回给所有等待同一刷新的调用者，取消其中一个 future 会影响其他调用者，后到的调用者可能拿到已取消的 future 并收到 CancellationException。

source_issues.title: Synchronous async-provider failures leave token-cache refresh futures unresolved
source_issues.evidence: provider 在返回 future 前抛出异常会绕过 completeAsync，预留的 future 保持未解决，后续调用者 join 一个未完成的 future 而永久挂起，强制刷新会令所有加入的调用者 pending。

signals.topic: 部分 compaction delta 合并丢失已累加的总结或加密元数据
signals.summary: 部分 compaction delta 合并会静默清除已累加的总结或加密元数据，导致消息重放数据不完整。
signals.review_reason: 在使用 BetaMessageAccumulator 进行消息压缩/重放的场景，部分 delta 合并会静默丢失已累加的总结或加密元数据，造成数据不完整，但需特定压缩重放使用模式，属低频边缘场景，标 P2。

source_issues.title: Partial compaction deltas erase accumulated summaries or encrypted metadata
source_issues.evidence: mergeCompactionDelta 把省略字段变成空 Optional 再转成显式 null，导致只含 content 的后续 delta 清除已建立的加密元数据，只含加密元数据的 delta 清除总结，省略两者时把缺失值转成显式 null。

signals.topic: SSE 状态机的 UTF-8 BOM 处理缺陷导致首个事件或错误被吞掉
signals.summary: SSE 状态机的 UTF-8 BOM 处理缺陷导致流式响应的首个事件或错误被静默吞掉。
signals.review_reason: 当服务端给 SSE 流加了标准允许的 UTF-8 BOM(事件流语法明确允许)时，首个事件或流式错误会被静默吞掉，影响首个消息或错误发现，属特定输入条件触发，标 P2。

source_issues.title: A leading UTF-8 BOM hides the first SSE event or error
source_issues.evidence: SSE 状态机把开头的 U+FEFF BOM 当作首字段名的一部分，流以 ﻿event: message_start 开头时丢失该事件，以 event:error 开头时可能隐藏流式错误，data: 为首字段时首个 payload 被丢弃。

signals.topic: 流式响应解析在真实/边界输入下崩溃,阻断调用方
signals.summary: SDK 的流式解析在多种非理想但合法的输入下直接抛异常:Bedrock 流遇到空 chunk 或 bytes 为 None 时 _chunk_bytes_to_sse 抛出 AttributeError 立即崩溃;普通文本/空首 delta 上调用 TextEvent.parsed_snapshot() 抛出 ValueError;带 UTF-8 BOM 前缀的合法事件流会漏读首事件,导致 message_start 丢失或 JSON 解析失败,同步/异步与 stable/beta 各类流式 helper 均受影响。这些都会让正在消费流式响应的用户主流程直接失败或拿到错误结果。
signals.review_reason: 这三处问题都落在用户实时消费流式响应的关键路径上:Bedrock 生产环境会收到的空 chunk、流式结构化输出的普遍 text delta、以及被代理/中间件改写的带 BOM 事件流,都会在无补救手段下直接抛异常或产出错误解析结果,属于可复现触发且缺乏用户自行规避入口的主流程阻断。

source_issues.title: Bug: _chunk_bytes_to_sse raises AttributeError when chunk.get('bytes') is None in Bedrock stream decoder
source_issues.evidence: Bedrock 流遇到空 chunk 帧或 chunk.get('bytes') 为 None 时,raw.decode() 对 None 调用导致 AttributeError,立即崩溃当前活动的 Bedrock 流。

source_issues.title: TextEvent.parsed_snapshot() raises ValueError on ordinary text (and on the empty first delta), and its return annotation is wrong for non-object JSON
source_issues.evidence: parsed_snapshot() 普通文本和空首 delta 上无保护地跑 jiter.from_json,抛出 ValueError;而该方法在流式响应中几乎每个 text delta 都会被调用,调用方若按事件类型无条件调用即崩溃。

source_issues.title: A leading UTF-8 BOM prevents streaming messages from reading the first event
source_issues.evidence: 合法事件流带 BOM 前缀时首字段不被识别,若为 message_start 则漏掉 start 事件,若为 data: 则首个 payload 被忽略导致 JSON 解析失败,同步/异步及 stable/beta 流式 helper 全部受影响。

signals.topic: 流式消费性能开销大,高 delta 响应造成事件循环阻塞
signals.summary: get_final_message()/迭代每个流式事件时,SDK 在 asyncio 事件循环上同步校验整个 RawMessageStreamEvent 联合体、为每个 delta 构建最终不会被读取的更高层事件对象,并对长 content 块做逐 delta 重分配与重复 JSON 解析。实测约 30-55 µs/事件,批量消费累计约 100s 事件循环时间,大的单个响应可达数百毫秒停顿,显著拖慢高频并发调用服务的吞吐与延迟。
signals.review_reason: 该问题由生产服务在并发消费大量流式消息时实测得出,会造成显著的事件循环阻塞和延迟上升,直接劣化高频调用服务的关键路径体验;虽非全部用户受影响,但在高并发/长流场景下有明确的性能代价。

source_issues.title: Streaming response consumption validates full event union per event on the loop, even for get_final_message()
source_issues.evidence: 流式消费在事件循环上同步校验完整事件联合体并为每个 delta 构建无用对象,实测 ~100s 事件循环时间,单个大响应数百毫秒停顿,相比请求侧耗时约 50 倍。

signals.topic: message_delta 缺失字段把先前已设的 stop_reason 等重置为 None,导致最终消息状态错误
signals.summary: accumulate_event 的 message_delta 分支对 stop_reason/stop_sequence/stop_details 无条件赋值,而相邻的 container 和 usage 字段有 None 保护。当后续 message_delta 省略这些可选字段时,前面 delta 已设的 stop_reason 会被重置为 None,并经由 current_message_snapshot 与 get_final_message() 暴露给调用方。调用方基于 stop_reason 做 refusal 处理、max_tokens 续写与工具循环终止判断,None 无法与'流未结束'区分,导致流程错误。
signals.review_reason: 在中间件/代理改写或消费仅带 usage 的后续 delta 时,最终消息的 stop_reason 会被静默清空,而调用方常依赖该字段做分支控制;属于可复现的状态错误,但作者也说明无法证明官方 API 总会触发,故为条件性痛点。

source_issues.title: streaming: a later message_delta that omits stop_reason resets it to None (container is guarded, the stop_* fields are not)
source_issues.evidence: 第二个仅带 usage 的合法 message_delta 会把已设的 stop_reason 从 end_turn 重置为 None,且该重置通过 get_final_message() 对调用方可见;调用方读到 None 无法区分'流从未结束'。

signals.topic: MCP 辅助对大小写/带参 MIME 类型的合法内容拒绝或跳过
signals.summary: MCP 转换辅助函数按字面比较 MIME 字符串,mcp_content 会拒绝 IMAGE/PNG 或 image/png;charset=binary 等含大小写变体或参数后缀的图片,mcp_resource_to_content 会跳过这类拼写并错误选择后面的资源。用户传入这些符合规范的 MIME 类型时,受支持的媒体会被拒收或数据丢失。
signals.review_reason: 使用 MCP 辅助的调用方传入合法但大小写/带参数的 MIME 类型时,受支持的图片或资源会被静默拒绝或选错,导致功能不可用或数据错位。范围较窄、属边界兼容性,为边缘改进项。

source_issues.title: MCP helpers reject or skip supported content with mixed-case or parameterized MIME types
source_issues.evidence: mcp_content(ImageContent(mimeType='IMAGE/PNG')) 抛出 UnsupportedMCPValueError,而等价小写类型可正常工作;资源转换会跳过此类受支持资源并选中后面的替代项。

signals.topic: 持续性思考流（Streaming）在不完整/被中断时把截断输出当成功并遗留永不 settle 的 promise，导致应用状态错误或挂起
signals.summary: MessageStream/BetaMessageStream 的 done() 在传输到达 EOF 但未收到终止 message_stop 事件时仍 resolve，应用会把截断的模型输出或不完整的 tool call 当成成功完成；同时 abort 取消时 emitted() 等待的 promise 永不 settle，造成挂起与资源泄漏。
signals.review_reason: 流式助手（MessageStream）是用户读取模型输出的核心路径。一个方向把 EOF 截断当成成功完成会让依赖 done() 的应用把不完整回复/未完成 tool call 当作有效结果直接消费；另一个方向在取消时让 emitted 等待永不 settle，导致应用挂起。两者都会造成用户可直接感知的状态错误或死等，属反复触发的工作流运行时问题。

source_issues.title: MessageStream.done() resolves when the stream ends without message_stop
source_issues.evidence: done() 与 BetaMessageStream.done() 在传输 EOF 未收到 message_stop 时仍成功 resolve，会导致应用把截断的模型输出或不完整 tool call 当作成功完成；提供最小复现与建议回归测试。open 且 4 条评论。

source_issues.title: MessageStream.emitted promises remain pending after the stream is aborted
source_issues.evidence: abort 触发时只发出 abort 事件而不发 error，emitted('message'/'finalMessage'/'text') 的 promise 永久 pending，done() 已拒绝但等待的 promise 不 settle，造成挂起与状态泄漏；附可复现案例。

signals.topic: 降级/拒绝回退中间件把会话错误固定到未成功服务的模型，并泄漏 abort 监听器
signals.summary: betaRefusalFallbackMiddleware 在回退请求结果未确定前就 pin 状态，拒绝链耗尽或请求失败后会把会话固定到从未成功提供回复的模型；同时流式回退在完成/取消后不清理 abort 监听器，长生命周期 signal 复用会累积监听器。
signals.review_reason: 回退/降级是模型拒绝或失败时的兜底路径，直接影响请求是否能在可用模型上继续。把会话错误固定到拒绝模型会让用户的下一条消息持续命中失败模型；abort 监听器泄漏在重试/复用的高频场景下累积内存。两者都是可反复出现的运行时行为缺陷，侵害核心 API 可用性。

source_issues.title: Fallback state is pinned to models that refuse or fail before serving a response
source_issues.evidence: 回退在发送请求前就更新 index，拒绝链用尽或请求失败后，后续请求被路由到从未成功服务的拒绝模型，与文档承诺的"保持在已接受模型"相悖；提供脚本化复现且已有 6 个回归测试。

source_issues.title: Streaming fallback middleware retains abort listeners after completion and cancellation
source_issues.evidence: 流式回退完成/源码读取失败/显式取消后 abort 监听器仍挂在原始 signal 上，复用同一长生命周期 signal 的连续请求每个都残留一个 controller/listener。

signals.topic: 认证/令牌处理在特定路径下中断：AWS 无 authToken 无法创建 EnvironmentWorker、同步抛错绕过令牌缓存恢复
signals.summary: 使用 @anthropic-ai/aws-sdk 的 Client 时因不设置 authToken（用 SigV4 签名）导致 EnvironmentWorker 无法创建，需填 dummy 值绕过；令牌提供器同步 throw 会绕过缓存正常恢复与刷新去重，即使有仍可用的缓存 token 也错误拒绝。
signals.review_reason: 认证是使用 SDK 的必经前置步骤。AWS 托管平台是官方支持的一等用例，环境无法创建直接阻断该路径（虽有 dummy 变通但属非预期 hacks）；同步令牌抛错会把本可成败的缓存 token 场景变成硬失败，破坏刷新恢复与去重，造成可靠的鉴权中断。两者都是用户可感知的功能不可用/不稳定。

source_issues.title: EnvironmentWorker cannot be created with the Client class from @anthropic-ai/aws-sdk
source_issues.evidence: AWS 的 Client 用 SigV4 签名鉴权、不设 authToken，导致 EnvironmentWorker 创建失败，需填 "dummy" 才能工作；open 状态、无修复。

source_issues.title: Synchronous token-provider failures bypass advisory recovery and refresh deduplication
source_issues.evidence: token provider 同步 throw 会绕过令牌缓存正常处理，仍可用的缓存 token 被忽略而错误拒绝，同时并发强制调用者各自独立调用失败的 provider。

signals.topic: 工具执行在结果投递失败重连后重复副作用（同一 tool 被再次执行）
signals.summary: SessionToolRunner 会话工具执行完成后若结果 POST 失败，重连会再次执行同一 tool-use ID，导致已完成的副作用/操作被重复执行，且无去重上限地逐次累加（一次重连两次执行、两次三次）。
signals.review_reason: 工具副作用重复执行是高风险的正确性缺陷：涉及可写操作（写库、下单、发消息、花钱的工具）时，一次网络抖动就触发重复副作用，造成多次执行/重复计费等可直接量化的成本与状态损坏。SDK 应当只重试未完成的结果投递而非重跑 handler，这是主流程上的显著伤害。

source_issues.title: SessionToolRunner repeats completed tool side effects after result delivery fails
source_issues.evidence: 工具结果 POST 失败导致同一 tool 被再次执行，内置与自定义调用都受影响，handler 抛错也会重复；已有测试明确期望两次运行，相关 Python 报告 #1749。

signals.topic: 结构化输出 schema 转换丢弃兄弟类型/组合约束，生成器可产出超出原 schema 的数据
